Verses.137:
You are righteous, LORD,
	and Your judgements are fair.
Verses.138:
You have given Your laws in righteousness
	and great faithfulness.
Verses.139:
I am consumed by my zeal
	when my enemies forget Your words.
Verses.140:
Your word is perfectly pure,
	and Your servant loves it.
Verses.141:
Though I am lowly and despised,
	I do not forget Your precepts.
Verses.142:
Your righteousness is everlasting,
	and Your law is truth.
Verses.143:
Trouble and anguish have seized me,
	yet Your commandments are my delight.
Verses.144:
Your laws are forever righteous;
	give me understanding that I may live.

Changes: 2024-05-27 - Paul Prins: First translation of psalm 119:137-144 based on Greek, Latin, and some Hebrew
